title: Reconstruct the Transformer
summary: Rebuild the Transformer's attention mechanism one piece at a time -- three questions to check understanding, then two graded implementations.

parts.title: Why scale by 1/sqrt(d_k)?
parts.prompt: Scores are QK^T divided by sqrt(d_k) before softmax. Explain what breaks as d_k grows if you drop the 1/sqrt(d_k) factor, and why scaling fixes it.
parts.answer: A dot product of two independent d_k-dim vectors has variance proportional to d_k, so raw scores grow with d_k. Very large scores push softmax into saturated regions where gradients vanish. Dividing by sqrt(d_k) normalizes the score variance back to ~1, keeping softmax well-conditioned.
hints: Consider the variance of a dot product of vectors with i.i.d. entries.
What does softmax do to inputs that are huge in magnitude?

parts.title: Why the causal mask?
parts.prompt: The decoder applies a causal (look-ahead) mask. What property does it enforce, and where in the computation must it be applied?
parts.answer: It enforces autoregression: position i may attend only to positions <= i, so the model cannot peek at future tokens during teacher-forced training and matches inference. The mask is applied to the scores BEFORE softmax (blocked entries set to a large negative), so they get ~0 probability.
hints: What leaks if position 2 could attend to position 5 during training?
Applying the mask after softmax would not zero contributions correctly.

parts.title: Why multiple heads?
parts.prompt: Multi-head attention splits d_model into h heads instead of one attention over the full dimension. What do multiple heads buy you?
parts.answer: Each head projects Q/K/V into a different subspace, so heads attend to different relationships in parallel (syntactic, positional, coreference, ...). Concat + Wo recombines these views. A single head must average all patterns into one distribution, losing the ability to represent several relations at once.
hints: A single softmax attention produces ONE distribution over positions.
Different projections = different notions of similarity.

parts.title: Implement scaled dot-product attention
parts.prompt: Implement attention(Q,K,V,mask=None) = softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d_k)) V. Apply the mask before softmax and keep softmax numerically stable.

parts.title: Implement multi-head attention
parts.prompt: Build on part 4: project X into Q/K/V, split into num_heads heads, attend per head, concatenate, and apply the output projection Wo.
